title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — September 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.2 (Peaked September 20, 2026 at 06:38 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 409 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Sunny's having an easy shift. 🌎🖤

A broad dark coronal-hole-like region stands out in today’s solar images, while sunspot activity remains limited.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
